[b][size=3]✨[/size] Version 2.0.0 update:[/b] These string lights emit real light and can be walked through as long as you download the optional mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Action Properties (MMAP)[/url]﻿! [size=3]✨[/size]

There are currently 13 different skins to choose from, some being animated!
The lights come in 3 different sizes, 3 different base colours (Dark/Light/Vanilla) and can be [b]purchased from Robin[/b] at her shop.

Once you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ installed you can purchase the "paint" tools from Robin's shop to change the texture/colour of the string lights. 

I[i] HIGHLY[/i] recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Building[/url]﻿ with this mod so that you can place furniture/craftables/etc. on restricted tiles.

[/s][color=#d9ead3][size=4] [b]Installation[/b][/size][/color][size=4][b]
[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI.[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]
[/url]2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures.[/url]﻿
4. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Action Properties (MMAP)[/url]﻿ (Optional for light emit and to be able to walk through the string lights).
5. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] (Optional for the shop descriptions).
6. Download the "[b](CP x AT) Shyzie's String Lights[/b]" mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]Mushymato[/url]﻿ for providing thorough assistance in converting the string lights to be usable with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Action Properties (MMAP)[/url]﻿ so that the string lights can finally actually emit real light and be walked through! ♡
